body: it is expected the Supreme Court will render an important decision on the religious rights of corporations. I fully support religious freedom for individuals, but I will be disappointed on many levels if the court gives corporations exemption from the laws of the land on religious grounds. Here’s a compilation of responses I and others wrote on the subject … and here’s a piece my friend Rich Cizik wrote.
